name: Rope Face Pull
steps: Set a rope attachment around face height and step back until the cable is taut.
Pull toward the forehead while separating the hands beside the face.
Keep elbows high enough to guide the pull without shrugging.
Return to extended arms with control.
cues: Keep ribs down and neck relaxed.
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the pull.
breathing: Exhale on the pull; inhale on the return.
